name: Junad
title: Software Developer
summary: Software developer working across systems, backend services, and user-facing applications. Interested in what happens beneath the abstraction: memory, runtimes, protocols, and the infrastructure that makes software dependable.

experience.summary: Full-stack development for business applications and internal tools.
bullets: Develop and maintain full-stack business applications using TypeScript, React, and relational databases.
Implement API integrations, data validation, and configurable workflows across customer-facing and internal applications.
Improve access controls, database tooling, and development workflows while maintaining existing services.

experience.summary: Native application development across the Apple ecosystem.
bullets: Developed and refactored SwiftUI applications with SwiftData and CloudKit integration.
Improved Flutter application responsiveness and maintained applications integrating Swift and Flutter components.

projects.name: Corex
projects.label: Compiler toolchain
projects.description: Exploring the path from source code to execution. A modular compiler toolchain built around pluggable backend targets.
bullets: Developed a modular compiler toolchain in Rust and Swift, designed around pluggable backend targets.

projects.name: Aegis
projects.label: Authentication infrastructure
projects.description: Headless authentication in Rust. Passwords, passkeys, multi-factor authentication, and a TypeScript SDK to connect it all.
bullets: Built a modular Rust authentication platform with WebAuthn passkeys, TOTP MFA, sessions, and role-based access control.
Integrated PostgreSQL, Redis, an asynchronous email outbox, and a TypeScript SDK; automated checks with GitHub Actions.

projects.name: Web Server
projects.label: Close to the metal
projects.description: A small TCP server written in AArch64 assembly. Working directly with the machinery underneath a network request.
bullets: Implemented a TCP server in AArch64 assembly, exploring low-level networking and system interfaces.

projects.name: Bloom Light
projects.label: Commerce & infrastructure
projects.description: An e-commerce platform spanning storefront, administration, and deployment infrastructure. Built through to production.
bullets: Delivered an e-commerce storefront and admin dashboard with containerized infrastructure, PostgreSQL, and object storage.
Automated deployments with GitHub Actions and configured private networking, reverse proxying, and TLS.
